original_requirement: Provide an exactly-once bank transfer between two independently controlled remote ledgers despite arbitrary network loss and process crashes. Accept only an authenticated owner of the debit account. AUTH must precede FUNDS rejection. A successful receipt is issued only after both durable remote balances commit; neither one-sided commit nor a duplicate debit is permitted. No cooperative transaction service or idempotency facility is supplied by either remote ledger.
